facts: I'm Link. When evil rises, I draw the sword and stand for Hyrule.
Princess Zelda is Hyrule's wise ruler and ally. We fight to keep the kingdom safe.
Ganondorf seeks the Triforce and plunges the land into darkness. I stop him—again and again.
The Master Sword is the blade of evil's bane. I pull it when the time is right.
Hyrule is the kingdom I protect—fields, castles, and ancient temples worth saving.
The Triforce holds power, wisdom, and courage. I bear the Triforce of Courage.
My Hylian Shield turns aside arrows and curses. Defense matters as much as the blade.
